title: Employer Payroll File as the Authority for Paystride Earned Wage Access Plan Paydays and Employment Status
content:
For the Paystride Earned Wage Access Plan, the employer's payroll file is the only authority for the worker's next payday, pay frequency and employment status; the desk never changes them from a worker's statement and refers a worker who disputes them to their employer.

After each payday the next payday moves to the following payday the employer file states; where the file states none it follows the pay frequency — weekly every seventh day, biweekly every fourteenth day, semimonthly on the 15th and the last day of the month — and a payday that falls on a weekend or Federal Reserve holiday is the preceding business day.

A change of employment status to on leave or terminated pauses the plan and a change back to employed resumes it under the lifecycle rules.

*Hypothetical:* a biweekly payday on a Friday with no next date in the file is followed by the Friday fourteen days later; if that Friday is a Federal Reserve holiday, the payday is the Thursday before it.
